elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason” and requires HDI, at the Company’s request, to provide reasonable transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for a period of up to 6 months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) provides for transition assistance “for a period of up to 6 months following the Termination Date.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(a) expressly states that assistance will be provided “at HDI’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires HDI to return to the Company all Company Content, user information, and customer data in HDI’s possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires return “within 30 days after the Termination Date.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor deletes that data from its systems.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI to “thereafter delete” the returned categories of data from its systems.

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor certifies the deletion to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(c) requires HDI to certify the deletion to the Company in writing.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3 applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and requires HDI to provide reasonable transition assistance at the Company’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The Company may request assistance for a period of up to 6 months, which includes a 90-day assistance period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor exports Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires HDI to return all specified Company data to the Company in a standard machine-readable format, satisfying the export requirement.

elements.element: Vendor completes the data export within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 4.3(b) requires the data return within 30 days after the Termination Date.

result.reason: The added operative provision satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also the fallback. It supplies the required trigger, assistance duration and rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, subsequent deletion, and written certification without altering the existing termination-payment provision or adding unrelated commercial obligations. Drafting is strong, though use of the capitalized “Termination Date” should align with an existing definition or be clarified to include contractual expiry.
